global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and menma bamboo shoots nestled atop noodles. Served in a decorative bowl with red characters and dragon motifs, it gleams under warm lighting against a dark background.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, matte table surface with subtle grain texture and faint, out-of-focus label corner visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragons, and red Chinese characters, glossy surface.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onion and leaf, shows rich brown color and glossy surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork slice shows layers of pink meat and white fat, with a slightly glistening surface and irregular, cooked edges.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, curved sticks with a glossy surface and visible fibrous texture.
